title: Reinvented interfaces deep-dive
ev: Black screen, a single glowing dot (the Jarvis orb)
USER: "Hey Jarvis." - orb wakes, rings pulse outward
Floating card shells fly in around the orb in 3D
USER: "Show me my day." - cards fill with content ($84.2K revenue etc.)
Cards dock into one "Your day" dashboard (to-do, reply draft, calendar, revenue)
Zoom out to a Mac desktop; the dashboard dissolves into particles
Title: "Interfaces, redesigned for the agentic era."
USER: "Hey Jarvis, who is still waiting on me?" - skeleton card
People waiting on you card: 4 people, built just now ("This screen did not exist until he asked")
JARVIS: "Four people."
JARVIS: "Tomas has waited 9 days." - row highlighted
USER: "Just the customers, and draft each one." - card reshapes to 2 rows with drafts
USER: "Send them."
JARVIS: "Both sent." - card collapses away
USER: "Now handle the rest of my morning."
16 task cards burst out in a grid, each WORKING
JARVIS: "On it. 16 things, all at once." - Time back today counter rises
USER: "And build the board deck." - Keynote: Q3 at a glance, Hiring pulled from Notion
Chip: Board deck ready - 6 slides; time back 2h 35m
USER: "Cancel the tools nobody used." - 4 tools nobody opened card
JARVIS: "One catch: Priya books her calls through Calendly."
JARVIS: "Keep it?"  USER: "Keep it." - Calendly kept, others cancelled
Card shrinks to a square and vanishes
USER: "How do my friends get you?"
JARVIS: "Join the waitlist." - card: agently.dev/jarvis, Request access
JARVIS: "I am letting people in a few at a time."
Desktop clears; zoom to black
End card: "No windows. No dashboards. Just ask." - Jarvis by Agently
